about.title: About DevStudio
about.subtitle: We are a global engineering team that believes great software should be reachable for every business.
story: DevStudio started in 2016 with three developers and one laptop. Our first project was a booking system for a small clinic that today handles thousands of visits a day.

We are now a 34-person team spread across four time zones, building products for businesses in Europe, the Middle East, North America and Asia around four specialisms: Python, mobile, modern web and AI.

We believe in transparent delivery: every client gets a progress dashboard, a weekly report and direct access to the engineering team. There are no hidden fees and the source code lives in a shared repository from day one.

values.title: Engineering honesty
